See rulings in 2:228-233.  A wife should not be divorced except after the completion of her menstrual period but before sexual intercourse has occurred, or else during a confirmed pregnancy.  The pronouncement of divorce begins her waiting period (ʿiddah).
Such as regret or renewed desire for the wife.
The ruling concerning pregnancy applies also in the case of the husband's death.
During their waiting period (referring to wives whose divorce has been pronounced).
So that they would be forced to leave or to ransom themselves.
Some scholars have interpreted "dhikr" here as "a reminder," meaning the Messenger (ﷺ), since he is mentioned in the following verse.
